situation.title: Security Situation
situation.subtitle: The detections this decision stands on
situation.none: No correlated situation — this alert predates cross-tool correlation.
situation.mergedInto: This situation was merged into {{id}} — the live decision is there.
situation.noUpstreamLink: No link configured for {{tool}} — search it there by rule and time.

factors.multiple_hosts: {{count}} hosts involved — consistent with lateral movement
factors.multiple_techniques: {{count}} distinct techniques asserted by the detecting tools: {{list}}

intel.title: Verification and precedent
intel.subtitle: What was checked against a source of record, and what this SOC decided before
intel.noProvider: No threat-intelligence provider is configured, so nothing here has been verified against a feed. This is not a clean result — it is no result.
intel.degraded: The {{provider}} feed could not be reached for part of this situation. Anything not listed below is unverified, not clean.
intel.noHits: No indicator in this situation matched the {{provider}} feed.
intel.notFound: {{count}} indicator(s) checked and not found — absence from a feed is not evidence of safety
intel.skipped: {{count}} not checked (internal addresses and identities are never sent to a feed)
intel.unverifiedTechniques: {{count}} technique(s) are not in the local ATT&CK catalogue: {{ids}}. The catalogue is a subset, so this means unconfirmed rather than invented.
intel.autoExecuted: Executed without a human, on precedent
intel.offered: {{count}} similar past decision(s) were put in front of the model; it cited {{cited}}.
intel.noPrecedent: No sufficiently similar past decision — this one waits for an analyst by construction.
intel.fabricated: The model cited case id(s) it was never given: {{ids}}. They were dropped, not stored.
